derivation: the main flow works. 2 things in the build do not match what you asked for — the mix-ratio status line and batches do not survive a restart (t-3-ac1, t-4-ac1) — and none of them is from the PRD itself: worth reading before you merge.

criteria.text: The board shows every recorded grout batch in one list on the page.
criteria.note: One list sits under the header with every batch on its own line — B-1041, B-1042 and B-1043, three rows, all on the one page.

criteria.text: A new batch can be added from the board itself, without leaving the page.
criteria.note: The add row is right there on the board: a 'new batch code' input with an ADD BATCH button beside it, so a batch is added without leaving the page.

criteria.text: The board names itself in a header so the tiler knows what he is looking at.
criteria.note: An orange band across the top (rgb(224,138,60)) reads GROUT TRACKER, naming the tool just as the drawing asks.

criteria.text: The batch list is the first thing under the header.
criteria.note: The header ends at y=51 and the list begins right below at y=71 — nothing between them, the list is the first thing under the header just as drawn.

criteria.text: An ADD BATCH button sits to the right of the input.
criteria.note: The input runs to x=1283 and the ADD BATCH button starts at x=1293 — the button sits to the right of the input, as drawn.

criteria.text: A status line beneath the add row shows the current mix ratio.
criteria.note: Your drawing has an orange mix-ratio line ('MIX RATIO 3:1 · 2 BATCHES OPEN') sitting beneath the add row. It isn't there at all — below the add row the page goes straight to the footer.
Your own test for this ran and went red — after a restart the batches were gone (it expected B-1041 back and got an empty list).

criteria.text: The export writes valid CSV with a header row.
criteria.note: Nothing on screen shows an export, and the test run has no line about CSV export — the suite doesn't cover it, so I could not check this.

gaps.title: the mix-ratio status line
gaps.expected: an orange mix-ratio line sitting beneath the add row
gaps.saw: nothing there — below the add row the page goes straight to the footer

gaps.title: batches do not survive a restart
gaps.expected: the batches you added still there after a restart
gaps.saw: an empty list — the stored batches were gone

alsoChecked: The ADD BATCH button is teal (rgb(90,166,184)); your drawing leaves the button colour as the builder's call, so I'm treating that as your call, not a fault.
There's a small grey footer, 'grout tracker · sandbox build', at the bottom; the drawing says nothing about a footer, so that's the builder's call too.
summary: Your three stated goals are all there: the batch list, the on-page add row, and the GROUT TRACKER header all match the drawing. Two things fall short — the orange mix-ratio status line the drawing puts beneath the add row is missing entirely (the page drops straight to the footer), and your own persistence test went red, batches don't survive a restart. The CSV export I couldn't check, nothing on screen or in the tests speaks to it.
